title: Room to Go Long: Belgian Waffle Ride Finds Its Ultra in Montana
content:
Sixteen years in the making, BWR’s new 200-plus-mile Brussels Waffle brings the first WUCA North American Gravel Ultra-Distance Championships to Bozeman.

Read the full article at Room to Go Long: Belgian Waffle Ride Finds Its Ultra in Montana on Velo.
author: Kelly Matkovich
